chunks: And through its chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
Whoever denies the intercession of God's Prophet will not benefit from it.
ai.seo_question: What happens to those who deny the Prophet's intercession?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (a.s.) links the efficacy of intercession directly to the believer's conviction, warning that denial nullifies its benefit. This highlights the Shia theological principle that shafa'ah is not automatic but contingent upon faith and divine permission, a concept further elaborated in the works of scholars like Al-Tabarsi. It underscores the necessity of believing in the Prophet's role as an intercessor on the Day of Judgment.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-293 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
“Whoever denies the intercession of God’s Prophet (S) will not benefit from it.”
